notes: Commercial retail property listings in Massachusetts and Connecticut. Listings are in a simple HTML table format. Each listing includes property location/address, square footage, property type (Endcap, In-Line, Pad Site, Office, Land), listing type (For Lease/For Sale), description, and contact information. PDF flyers are linked from the title/address column. No traditional pricing displayed - properties are for lease or sale. Static HTML page, no pagination needed.
